# Syntax.TcInput

<!-- Generated by `prism docs` from `lib/std/Syntax/TcInput.pr`. Do not edit by hand. -->

Typed vocabulary for the `prism-tc-input-v1` checker-input artifact.

The document is the declaration interface consumed by the Rust checker. Its function bodies are NodeIds into `prism-resolved-syntax-v1`; no inferred Rust facts appear here.

## Types

### `TcImport`

```prism,def,h-e6e8d50d33b2a8f61d31f374e97db52c0de4bc66843018e0d81a1e0e93f15194
type TcImport = TcImport {
  path: String,
  names: List(String),
  glob: Bool
} deriving (Eq, Show)
```

One import the module takes: the module path, the names taken from it, and whether the list was written as a glob.


### `TcData`

